description: Get an automated property valuation with comparables. Billed $5.00 per call on pay-as-you-go, so confirm the user accepts the charge before calling, and included on the unlimited plan. Returns price estimates, confidence scores, up to 10 comparable properties and model metrics. Find the property_id first with search_endpoint or properties_endpoint. For a value over time, predict_endpoint is billed per predicted value instead.

ScenarioOverrides.description: What-if property changes accepted by both /avm and /predict.

garage_type_first.description: Garage type. Use field_detail on garage_type_first for accepted values.

property_type.description: Property type. Use field_detail on property_type for accepted values.

overrides.description: What-if changes to the property before valuing it, for scenario testing (a finished basement, an extra bathroom). Anything left out keeps the property's real value.

price_quote.description: Return the cost of this request without billing it or returning data

property_id.description: Property ID, one per call. Every call is billed at the price in this tool's description.

name: avm_endpoint
